name: Sinister Strike
description: A quick strike that generates combo points.

name: Eviscerate
description: Finishing move that deals damage based on combo points.

name: Pickpocket
description: Steal gold and items from an unsuspecting target.

name: Sap
description: Incapacitate a target from stealth.

name: Kick
description: A swift kick that interrupts spellcasting.

name: Gouge
description: Gouge the eyes of an enemy, incapacitating them briefly.

name: Blind
description: Throw powder to blind an enemy, disorienting them.

name: Sprint
description: Greatly increase movement speed for a short time.

name: Evasion
description: Increase dodge chance dramatically for a duration.

name: Cloak of Shadows
description: Remove harmful effects and become immune to magic briefly.

name: Distract
description: Throw an object to distract enemies, turning them away.

name: Cheap Shot
description: Stun an enemy from stealth.

name: Kidney Shot
description: Finishing move that stuns based on combo points.

name: Slice and Dice
description: Finishing move that increases attack speed.

name: Expose Armor
description: Finishing move that reduces enemy armor.

name: Feint
description: Perform a feint, reducing damage taken from area attacks.

name: Dismantle
description: Disarm the enemy, preventing weapon attacks.

name: Tricks of the Trade
description: Transfer threat to an ally and boost their damage.

name: Marked for Death
description: Mark a target, generating full combo points on them.

name: Death from Above
description: Leap into the air and crash down on enemies for massive damage.
